dialect.detail: GnuCOBOL (OpenCOBOL) with SCREEN SECTION and LOCK MODE IS MANUAL on indexed file; Brazilian Portuguese comments; likely compiled with GnuCOBOL for a training/evaluation exercise at HBSIS/Ambev
evidence: SCREEN SECTION with LINE/COL/BLANK SCREEN clauses
LOCK MODE IS MANUAL on INDEXED file
No EXEC CICS or EXEC SQL

purpose.domain_detail: Customer registration system for HBSIS/Ambev evaluation exercise; manages client records with CNPJ (Brazilian tax ID), company name, latitude and longitude
purpose.summary: This program implements a customer (client) registration menu system with options to include, alter, delete, and import client records. It uses an indexed VSAM-like file (ARQCLI01) and a sequential import file (ARQIMPCL). The program was written as an evaluation/assessment exercise for HBSIS/Ambev by Tadeu Costa de Oliveira in March 2019.

notable_features: Indexed file with ALTERNATE KEY and LOCK MODE IS MANUAL
Multiple screen definitions (TELA-CLIENTE, TELA-ADD-CLIENTE, TELA-ALT-CLIENTE, TELA-EXC-CLIENTE, TELA-BUSCA-CLIENTE)
No COPY books, no CALL statements
verdict.notes: Source truncated at 16000 chars out of 22315 bytes; the PROCEDURE DIVISION is partially visible. Program is clearly a training/evaluation exercise (header states 'AVALIACAO - HBSIS/AMBEV'). GnuCOBOL dialect inferred from SCREEN SECTION usage and absence of IBM-specific features; could also be Micro Focus but GnuCOBOL is more consistent with the open-source/training context.
